name: Kongdeng Shanye
source:
An Illuminator belonging to the elite force of Starshard Beacon, somewhat uncommunicative. She always dresses in dark colors, which might benefit her movement at night.

[spoiler]Spectrica seems to trust her very much as Kira is her henchwoman. She is one of the vice leaders of Light Pollution.

She is good at infiltrating, and is strong when fighting in head-on combat. It is said that she is way stronger when she fights Illuminators instead of Darkritters. However, as a teammate, she is always reliable.[/spoiler]
